authenticity_review: The image exhibits high-quality rendering in terms of lighting, texture (wax and brass), and composition. However, it suffers from significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation: the 'fusion' of candles directly into trumpet tubing without logical holders, and the morphological collapse of the trumpets themselves (missing mouthpieces, indistinct valve mechanisms, impossible tubing connections). These are not graphical distortions (noise/blur) but semantic/structural hallucinations. The authenticity score reflects this trade-off: photorealistic surface quality vs. physically impossible object interaction.

Structural fusion: Candles emerge directly from brass tubing without holders
